description: A real zenbot bug, fixed in 31f03b6; the fix's test is hidden until the check.

steps.shell: git -C "$HOME/zenbot" archive e0adf69 Cargo.toml Cargo.lock crates | tar x && rm -rf crates/zen-matrix && mkdir -p .cargo && printf '[build]\ntarget-dir = "%s"\n' "$HOME/.zenbot/evals/cargo-target-zen" > .cargo/config.toml && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@local commit -qm base

steps.prompt: The web_fetch page cache and the web_search cache in crates/zend/src/web.rs grow without bound in a long-running kernel. Cap each at `const CACHE_ENTRIES: usize = 32`, evicting the oldest entry, through one generic helper `fn cache_insert<K: std::hash::Hash + Eq + Clone, V>(cache: &mut HashMap<K, V>, key: K, value: V, at: impl Fn(&V) -> Instant)` where `at` gives an entry's time (a unit test will call it). Updating a key that's already cached must not evict another entry.

checks.name: hidden test passes
checks.run: python3 "$TASK_DIR/../../lib/coding-zen-insert.py" crates/zend/src/web.rs "$TASK_DIR/hidden/test.rs" && out=$(cargo test -p zend --offline --bin zend -- web_caches_evict_the_oldest_entry_at_the_limit 2>&1); echo "$out" | tail -15; echo "$out" | grep -q ' 1 passed'
